runs.text:
Disciples of the Sun is the fourth studio album by the Danish power metal band Pyramaze, released on 22 May 2015.
This album features a significantly different lineup than the band's previous records. Pyramaze recruited vocalist Terje Harøy to replace Matt Barlow and Urban Breed after their departures, and producer Jacob Hansen replaced Michael Kammeyer on guitars while remaining the band's producer. The album's title track had a music video produced to promote the album, a first for the band.
